comparison.objective: Insert opposed tapered shims behind a door jamb until snug without excessive bow.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual thin-part insertion from opposite faces, wedge overlap, and force-sensitive depth control.
comparison.success_condition: Opposed shims overlap at the hinge, close the gap to the feeler-gauge threshold, limit jamb bow, and remain released and still.
comparison.reason: This tests coupled wedge insertion and structural force control in a fixed gap, not moving-object rejection or level transport of spill-prone contents.
